title: design-13 is half fixed: during playback the cards still show a t that is not the main t
detail: The playing card now has the accent outline. That part works. The t labels do not. The ledger says a held card hides its t label. In the running v15 the label stays visible during playback and keeps the old value. Example: f2 selected, the deformation paused at T = 1.2, then the real Play button. While the main T runs 1.07, 1.57, 1.99, the f2 card reads 't = 0.20' the whole time. No card gets the class 'stale', so the rule '.card.stale .tlab { visibility: hidden }' never applies. renderThumbs adds 'stale' only when something calls it during playback, and nothing does. v15_desktop_cmd checks the labels only while paused, so it passes.
evidence: work/vfy15/probe/vfy3.js (queue output work/vfy15/test/vfy15_cdp/q/80.out): samples 'play+250' to 'play+500' give m.T 1.07 / 1.57 / 1.99 and card 2 'sel quiet playing:visible t = 0.20'. Shot work/vfy15/test/vfy15_cdp/shots/vf3-playing.png. Also vf-morph-playing.png: bar 't = 2.00 / 3', f2 card 't = 0.50'. src/app.js:6462-6464 (renderThumbs), src/desk.css:262.
fix: When playback starts in the deformation card kind, add 'stale' to every card whose picture is held (or hide all .tlab while morph.playing). Remove it when the cards are redrawn after the pause. Add a check to v15_desktop_cmd: press #morphPlay, sample twice, and require that no visible card label differs from the card's current t.

title: russian-13 (d) and (e) are fixed in the tour but not in the guide
detail: The guide's chain paragraph in Russian still says «Собственные коэффициенты шага несут его номер» and «Двойное нажатие на карточку или лупа в инспекторе показывает только этот шаг». The ledger marks (d) and (e) fixed. Only the tour strings changed. The English source of the same paragraph still says 'carry its index'.
evidence: src/i18n_ru.js, the entry for the key that starts 'Add a step with {x}, the add card, or a connector's insert button; … Click a card to select it: the Inspector' (used at src/app.js:11788). grep: «несут его номер» 1 hit, «помечены его номером» 2 hits (tour).
fix: In the ru table: «Собственные коэффициенты шага помечены его номером (a₂)» and «Двойной щелчок по карточке или лупа в инспекторе показывает только этот шаг». English: 'A step's own coefficients are marked with its index (a₂)'. Regenerate with tools/make_ru_table.py.

title: math-6: the new Inspector note prints a hyphen as the minus and reads awkwardly
detail: The degenerate Möbius note reads 'f₁ is constant, = 1; z = -1 is removable.' The value comes from A.fmt, so −1 is printed with an ASCII hyphen. Everywhere else the app writes U+2212. ', = 1' is not a sentence form. The letters z and f are upright, not italic as in the formulas above it.
fix: Format both numbers with the true minus (as planemenu fmtR does). Use 'f₁ is constant (= 1); z = −1 is a removable singularity.' Set z and f₁ in math italics, as the determinant line is.

title: design-17 / math-14: zero and pole fields still show '-0.5i' and '-0.8+0.75i'
detail: Parameters now use U+2212 in the range ends, the slider name and the idle value field. The zero and pole fields still show the ASCII hyphen and unspaced +. The ledger keeps them on purpose (stored text, read by tests). So the two kinds of field in one Inspector now disagree: 'a = −0.3' next to 'ζ₂ = -0.5i'. The finding asked for the true minus where the field is not focused.
evidence: work/vfy15/test/vfy15_cdp/shots/vf4-phone-edit.png (ζ₂ '-0.5i', p₁ '-0.8+0.75i'). src/params.js:410-416 shows the display-only swap that Parameters use.
fix: Use the same display-only swap on the zero and pole fields while they are not focused; keep the stored text unchanged. Or ask the user whether the stored-text form is acceptable here.

title: regress-6: the reason for keeping the dead code has lapsed
detail: The ledger rejected regress-6 to keep the 3-way merge with v14's fixes clean. That merge is done: V15-INTEGRATION section 3 merged v14's gate fixes into v15. The dead code is still in the shipped v15: buildProps, fillProps, renderRail and openCardPop are defined once and never called, and page.html still styles .card-pop.
evidence: grep in work/vfy15/src: buildProps, fillProps, renderRail, openCardPop each 1 hit in app.js (the definition); 'card-pop' 3 hits in app.js and 1 in page.html. notes/workflows/V15-INTEGRATION.md section 3.
fix: Delete them in one patch with no other changes, as the finding said. Re-run the node tests and v15_desktop_cmd after it.

title: design-22: the deferred header check is now due, and the 768 header still differs from frame f6
detail: The ledger deferred design-22 until after the v14 merge. The merge is done. At 768 the header still shows only Undo, Redo, X → Y, Phase, Landscape, Deformation and More. Frame f6 keeps Examples, search, the two panel toggles, export, language, theme, sound and help. At 1024 all of them are there.
evidence: work/vfy15/probe/vfy2.js (q/60.out): hdr768 = [Undo, Redo, X → Y, Phase, Landscape, Deformation, More]; hdr1024 has Examples, search, both toggles, export, theme, sound, language, help. Shot work/vfy15/test/vfy15_cdp/shots/vf2-hdr-768.png. Mockup notes/ui-redesign-2/desktop/shots/after-f6-xy-768-light.png.
fix: Compare the 768 and 1024 headers with frames f5 and f6 now. Either bring the header to f6 or record the user's choice to keep the More menu at 768. Add a header check at 768 to v15_desktop_cmd.

title: russian-7 is fixed for the name field only; a value field still hides a Cyrillic letter
detail: A Cyrillic «с» as a new number's name now becomes c, and other Cyrillic letters get the clear message. In a number's value field, «с» is still folded to c and reported as «c₀ не задано». The user typed a Russian letter, but the message names a Latin c with a subscript that the user never typed. The finding's detail named this case.
evidence: work/xva/test/rur2_cdp/cmd/run10.js run on v15 (q/70.out): cyrName2 = {msg: «c₀ не задано», params: [a]}. Name field: work/vfy15/out/pr_p11.json afterEnter params [c].
fix: When an unknown name in a value or formula field came from a Cyrillic look-alike, say so in the same words as the name field («Буква «с» — русская: …»), or read it as the Latin letter only when that letter is a known number.

title: russian-6 edge: the language switch changes the selection when Show alone is on another step
detail: With f1 shown alone and f2 selected, switching the language reloads with f1 selected. The numbers and the alone mode are kept. Without Show alone the selection is kept, as the ledger says. The rule for russian-6 is that the switch keeps the selection.
evidence: work/vfy15/probe/vfy4.js (q/90.out): switchBefore {focus 1, sel [2], Inspector f2 Zeros and poles}; switchAfter {focus 1, sel [1], Inspector f1 Дробно-линейная}.
fix: Stash the selection on its own in the switch hook and restore it after focus. Or, if a selection other than the alone step is not meant to exist, make the click on f2 leave Show alone, so the state before the switch is consistent.

title: design-4: the w list under F sets its fractions in text style, smaller than the line above
detail: The fix writes F in terms of the last w and lists the w's under it. That fits the panel at every width (checked at 1440, 1280 and 1024, English and Russian). But w₂ = (w₁ − 1)/(w₁ + 1) is a small inline fraction, about two thirds of the size of F's fraction and of w₁ = e^z. It reads as a footnote, not as part of the same display.
evidence: work/vfy15/probe/vfy1.js (q/50.out): no Inspector formula wider than its well. Shots work/vfy15/test/vfy15_cdp/shots/vf-F-1440-en.png and vf-F-1024-ru.png.
fix: Set the w list with \dfrac (or displaystyle) when it fits, and fall back to the inline fraction only when it does not.

title: tour_cmd: the reduced-motion check failed once under load (93 of 94); regress-4 itself passes
detail: The Phase callout check from regress-4 now passes. A different check failed in the full run: 'reduced motion: no card transition, the cut-out jumps' (the duration was 0s, so the shade path changed or was still changing at the fixed 320 ms wait). Run alone, it passes: 0s, changed, settled at 320 ms. The load average was about 10. The new layout() tries up to three wider cards before it falls back, so a step can take longer to place under load. I did not prove that link.
evidence: work/vfy15/out/tour_cmd.json (pass 93 of 94). Isolated rerun: work/vfy15/probe/vfy2.js, q/60.out 'reduced' {tr 0s, changed true, settledAt320 true}.
fix: In tour_cmd, wait until the shade path stops changing (poll two frames) instead of a fixed 320 ms. Re-run tour_cmd at low load before the gate.
